fusions.name: Pressed Flat
fusions.desc: Charges up to 5 tiles at an enemy and lands on it with every arm, dealing 14 damage and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Hindered] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Falling Bulk
fusions.desc: Drops your whole weight on the ground around you, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 6% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Curled for Winter
fusions.desc: Restores 4 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Bulk That Regrows
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 14, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
